content: Khronos glTF 2.0 specifies .glb and model/gltf-binary, a GLB magic header and version checks. The official glTF Validator checks GLBv2 structure, schema, references, buffers, images and resources. A dummy artifact must be structurally valid, hash-verified bytes, and loadable in the browser; displacement output must be labeled as a fallback rather than mislabeled as GLB.
